Java Developer, Trellis Systems — Oct 2024 - Apr 2026

Implemented Hibernate-based persistence patterns and optimized queries on RDS-backed schemas, reducing average transaction latency by ~30%. Integrated S3 for archival storage and used CloudWatch metrics and alarms to track service health. Collaborated via Git and documented API designs in Confluence.

Software Engineer, Covalent Infotech — Nov 2021 - Sep 2024
Developed event-driven pipelines using Apache Kafka to decouple order ingestion and processing, increasing throughput by 2x. Implemented Java-based consumers and producers with efficient MySQL storage patterns and connection pooling; migrated critical tables to RDS for managed backups and failover. Instrumented application logs and metrics in CloudWatch and automated deployments with Docker images stored in private registry. Used Git for version control and maintained runbooks in Confluence.

Skills: Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Kafka, RDS, CloudWatch, S3, Docker, Hibernate, Git, Confluence
